title: GTA 6 Breaks Massive Livestreaming Record in First Week
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has reportedly set a massive livestreaming record, dominating Twitch, YouTube, and Kick with unmatched viewer numbers.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Dominates Livestreaming Platforms

Grand Theft Auto 6 has broken yet another major milestone in the gaming world. According to a report by Eurogamer, after attracting more viewers on its launch day than any game in history, Rockstar's open-world crime simulator has continued to heavily dominate streaming platforms such as Twitch, YouTube, and Kick throughout its first week.

## Unprecedented Viewer Numbers

The scale of the viewership is truly staggering. Reports indicate that the game's first-week watch time on streaming platforms surpassed the combined totals of several major titles, including Elden Ring, Diablo 4, Valorant, and Lost Ark. This ongoing dominance highlights the extraordinary level of global anticipation and engagement surrounding Rockstar's latest release.

## Editor's Take

GTA 6 breaking streaming records to this magnitude is a testament to the cultural behemoth that the franchise has become. The sheer volume of concurrent viewers tuning in across platforms demonstrates a level of community engagement that rarely comes around in the gaming industry.
